newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE -- East Hartford, Conn.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- East Hartford, Conn.

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Town of East Hartford, Connecticut, at Fleet Securities, Inc., 777 Main Street, 17th Floor Conference Room, Hartford, Connecticut, subject to the provisions of the official Notice of Sale dated December 16, 1996.

maturing $780,000 on January 15 in each of the years 1998- 2007, both inclusive; and LOTB: $1,280,000 Taxable Bonds, maturing $125,000 on January 15 in each of the years 1998- 2004, both inclusive, and $135,000 on
January 15 in each of the years 2005-2007, both inclusive. Interest Paid: January 15 and July 15 in each year,
commencing July 15, 1997 Legal Opinion: Robinson & Cole

The Tax-Exempt Bonds shall NOT be designated by the Town as qualified tax exempt obligations under the provisions of Section 265(b) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, for purposes of the deduction by financial

institutions for interest expense allocable to the Tax- Exempt Bonds. For copies of the official Notice of Sale, the Official Statement of the Town of East Hartford, Connecticut, dated December 16, 1996, and bid forms, please contact Ms. Elizabeth Schramek, Fleet Securities, Inc., 777 Main Street, Hartford, Connecticut 06115 (860-986-2776).
